mapper.select: SELECT N.NOTICE_SEQ, N.TITLE, N.NOTICE_YN, N.READ_CNT, U.USER_NAME, N.USER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(N.REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS REG_DT FROM NOTICE N INNER JOIN USER_INFO U ON N.USER_ID = U.USER_ID ORDER BY N.NOTICE_YN, N.REG_DT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTICE ( TITLE, NOTICE_YN, CONTENTS, USER_ID, READ_CNT, REG_ID, REG_DT, CHG_ID, CHG_DT ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{noticeYn}, #{contents}, #{userId}, 0, #{userId}, NOW(), #{userId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT N.NOTICE_SEQ, N.TITLE, N.NOTICE_YN, N.READ_CNT, U.USER_NAME, N.USER_ID, N.CONTENTS, DATE_FORMAT(N.REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS REG_DT FROM NOTICE N INNER JOIN USER_INFO U ON N.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE N.NOTICE_SEQ = #{noticeSeq}
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE SET TITLE = #{title}, NOTICE_YN = #{noticeYn}, CONTENTS = #{contents}, CHG_ID = #{userId}, CHG_DT = NOW() WHERE NOTICE_SEQ = #{noticeSeq}
